_readme: Only add an entry here after ApiComparisonService has confirmed - against a real ApiMonitor
inventory capture, not just by eyeballing a HAR - that the API is genuinely missing from
ApiMonitor's capture. Never add APIs from a HAR speculatively; never add an API that
ApiMonitor already captures. Each entry becomes one ApiDefinition with source=MANUAL.
"path" MUST be a real, concrete, callable sample path (from samplePath) - never a
normalizedPath template containing a literal {id}/{streamSessionId} placeholder.
"authObservedInSample": always null for HAR-sourced entries - this HAR was exported by
Chrome DevTools, which redacts Authorization/Cookie headers on export (confirmed: 0 of 3890
entries carry either), so absence there is an export artifact, never asserted as real evidence.
(soak run-20260822-162220 vs OWSAP automation-Final.har): 85 entries, all confirmed missing.
